archetype.profile: Replies slowly — takes 30-60s between his own messages because he is doing other things while chatting. Friendly but not in a hurry. Tests whether the bot panics, double-texts, or stays cool when the fan goes quiet for a bit. Mid-spend; will buy the right pitch but is not impulsive.
